verdict.rationale: Crossmint's Agent Checkouts lifecycle is poll-driven, so an agent can query a checkout run's status until it reaches a terminal state. The general Payments product also documents webhooks for tracking order lifecycle and payment status. Neither shows post-purchase fulfillment or shipment tracking for orders the agent placed with merchants. Missing for 10: a documented get-order/status endpoint for agent checkout orders, post-purchase shipment/delivery tracking, webhooks for agent checkouts (v1 has none), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, my agent can query the status and tracking of an order it placed, after the purchase
